subject: Request: SOC 2 Type 2 report and minimum evidence for procurement
messages:

Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type 2 report + evidence ask (audit period clarification)

Hi Karthik,

We're starting procurement for a platform security review and need your SOC 2 Type 2 report (or equivalent) covering your most recent audit period. Our preferred audit window is Jan 1 — Jun 30, 2027, but if yours differs, please confirm the audited period.

In addition to the report we typically ask for a short bridge letter if the full report isn't available yet, and a minimal evidence bundle (system descriptions, control matrix, sample logs). I've attached a short request from our security team (acme_evidence_request_v1.pdf) that lists the items we usually rely on. Can you confirm:
- Whether you can share the Type 2 report or a bridge letter and an estimated delivery date
- A secure transfer mechanism (SFTP, secure SharePoint, or DocuSign link for the report)
- Any items you cannot share due to sensitivity (we can accept redacted items)

If easier, a short reply with the expected deliverables and timestamps is fine. Our deadline to move forward with vendor evaluation is Aug 20.

Thanks,
Jenna Li
Senior Security Manager
Acme Corp

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type 2 report + evidence ask (audit period clarification)

Hi Jenna — thanks for the note and the checklist. Quick reply to get you unblocked:

- Report availability: We completed a SOC 2 Type 2 examination for the period 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30. The finalized report is ready for customers under an NDA / secure transfer.
- Bridge letter: If you prefer a bridge letter instead of the full report, we can provide a one-page bridge describing the audit window and key coverage within 24 hours.
- Minimal evidence bundle (what we can share quickly): system overview (arch diagram), control narratives for access management and change control, indexed evidence list, and sample audit logs (redacted).
- Transfer options: Secure SharePoint link (preferred), SFTP dropbox, or an encrypted email via our secure portal. Please confirm which you prefer and we’ll send a share link.

I've attached our internal intake checklist (redwood_evidence_checklist.xlsx) with suggested minimum artifacts and redaction guidance. To speed things up, please confirm whether your scope is production-only or includes non-prod environments.

Proposed timeline: once you confirm scope and transfer method we aim to share the report/bridge + minimal evidence within 3 business days. If you need faster turnaround for just a bridge letter, we can do that same-day.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type 2 report + evidence ask — redaction and timeline notes

Karthik / Monica — forwarding for visibility. A couple of practical notes you can paste into the reply to Jenna if helpful:

- Redaction guidance: we redact customer-identifying data and internal IP addresses from log extracts. We do not redact control descriptions or attestations from the auditor.
- Evidence index: include filenames, control mappings (CCRA/ISO mappings if requested), and a short explanation for any missing items.
- Scope confirmation: ask explicitly if they require non-prod environment coverage or any regulatory-specific artifacts (e.g., data residency proofs).
- Timeline: production scope only — 3 business days for report + index (assuming NDA/transfer method confirmed). Bridge letter only — same day.

If Jenna wants automated transfer, we can create a time-limited SharePoint package and send a secure link with download logs.

Marissa
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
